description: Control per-workspace and global access to an integration, including cost/rate limits, usage resets, and automatic default-provider creation. global_workspace_access_enabled affects current and future workspaces; override_existing_workspace_access determines whether it replaces explicit workspace settings. Per-workspace default-provider fields override top-level values. Review list_integration_workspaces first because access and limits change downstream usage immediately.

create_default_provider.description: Auto-create providers when granting workspace access

default_provider_slug.description: Default slug for providers auto-created in workspaces

global_alert_threshold.description: Global cost alert threshold applied to workspace access

global_credit_limit.description: Global cost credit limit applied with global workspace access

global_rate_limit_rpm.description: Global requests-per-minute limit for workspace access

global_workspace_access_enabled.description: Enable or disable access for all current and future workspaces

override_existing_workspace_access.description: Apply global settings over existing per-workspace access

workspaces.description: Array of workspace configurations to update

create_default_provider.description: Override whether a provider is auto-created for this workspace

default_provider_slug.description: Override the auto-created provider slug for this workspace

enabled.description: Whether the workspace has access to this integration

rate_limit_rpm.description: Rate limit in requests per minute

reset_usage.description: Reset exhausted usage status to active

name: update_integration_workspaces

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
